data.narrative:
Fourth Power is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Asegun Henry and Arvin Ganesan that has raised $40M+. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers and one public comparable (Lonza, LNZA), including frontier firms such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow valuation tier needed for robust median-based triangulation.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using the $40M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $80M. This reflects the standard capital injection and risk reduction expected between seed/early Series A and later growth stages, absent deeper market comparables.

The valuation analysis supports a range of $68M to $92M, with a median point of $80M. This range incorporates downside and upside sensitivities around the stage-progression anchor. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly comparable peer valuations at identical stage and capital deployment profile, limiting precision of the estimate. The frontier nature of the Climate & Energy sector—particularly emerging technologies in materials and energy storage—compounds comparability risk. Additional data on Fourth Power's revenue, deployment metrics, or capital efficiency relative to named peers would strengthen conviction in this range.
